notes: Valcom VIP-201A ("PagePro IP") is a SIP-based paging server: 1 zone of one-way analog paging output plus up to 8 zones of IP paging. Manufacturer product page (valcom.com) confirmed dimensions (1.75"H x 16.60"W x 5.40"D, 4.65 lbs), PoE 802.3af support, and 1 analog paging output; the manufacturer's own Installation/Technical Spec PDFs (valcom.com/valcom.co.uk) returned dynamic-page/403 errors when fetched directly, so detailed connector info was confirmed from a third-party mirror of Valcom's official Installation Manual and Technical Specification documents (manualslib.com/manual/2041516). No rackUnits set — despite a 1U-height (1.75") chassis, the 16.6" width and documentation give no confirmation of 19" rack-mount ears; likely shelf/wall-mount. Ethernet port speed (10/100 vs Gigabit) is never stated in either the manufacturer page or the manual, so no eth-* grade was applied per instructions. "Page Output" and "AUX Audio Out" are physically fixed screw-terminal blocks on the rear panel (not pluggable Euroblock connectors); euroblock was used as the closest available connector id in the given list — same reasoning applied to the two Form C relay terminals (K1/K2). Category/type (audio / Encoder/Decoder) is a best-fit judgment call since the connector list offers no dedicated "paging gateway" type — the device functionally decodes/converts network SIP audio into analog paging output.

ports.name: Network (PoE)
ports.note: RJ-45 network/SIP connection; also carries Power over Ethernet, IEEE 802.3af Class 3. Cat 3 or better UTP. Ethernet link speed (10/100 vs Gigabit) not stated in documentation, so no bandwidth grade is set.

ports.name: +24V DC Input
ports.note: Optional external DC power (non-PoE), 24VDC @ 325mA via rear panel barrel/2.5mm jack; used with optional Valcom VIP-324D power supply when PoE is not available.

ports.name: AUX Audio In
ports.note: Auxiliary analog audio input (e.g. background music/paging source), RCA jack, 8-600 ohm, -10dBm nominal.

ports.name: Page Output
ports.note: Multi-pin screw terminal block feeding up to 40 Valcom one-way self-amplified speakers; carries AUDIO, CC PAGE (page-initiate), RING (night-ring) and +24VDC/speaker power conductors. Closest listed connector type to the fixed screw-terminal block actually used.

ports.name: AUX Audio Out
ports.note: Transformer-coupled line-level audio output terminal for driving 25V/70V central paging amplifiers, 50 ohm, -10dBm nominal. Screw terminal block (euroblock used as closest listed connector id).

ports.name: Relay K1
ports.note: Programmable Form C dry-contact relay closure (COM/N.O./N.C. on a screw terminal block), 1A @ 24VDC; asserts during paging.

ports.name: Relay K2
ports.note: Second programmable Form C dry-contact relay closure, same terminal block/rating as Relay K1.
